\section{\texttt{migrate\_legacy\_chunks}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.source_ids.migrate_legacy_chunks}\index{Functions!migrate\_legacy\_chunks}

Rebuild version-1 source and chunk IDs without changing text or metadata.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
migrate_legacy_chunks(chunks: list[DocumentChunk]) -> list[DocumentChunk]
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{chunks}] \texttt{list[DocumentChunk]\allowbreak{}}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{list[DocumentChunk]\allowbreak{}}
\apifield{Raises}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{SourceIdMigrationError}] If identities disagree, chunk positions cannot be recovered, or migration would produce duplicate chunk IDs.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}Metadata distinguishes records whose old identifiers collided. Older default-tenant chunks without identity metadata use their raw source ID as the feedback ID. Chunk positions are retained, as is list order, so vectors remain aligned without recomputing embeddings.
